translations.web: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
translations.bsb: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
translations.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
translations.asv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.
